question.text: Which one of the following statements regarding the population of different conformers butane-2, 3-diol is true?

options.text: The most populated conformer will have the hydroxyl groups of the gauche position.
The most populated conformer will have the hydroxyl groups at the anti position.
All staggered conformations will be equally populated.
Relative populations of different conformers is not predictable

solution.text: Intramolecular hydrogen bonding is possible in this conformation which makes is more stable than anti form.
